To get the best result from your new spice rack, installation and setup are quick and easy—all you need is a Phillips screwdriver:
1. Attach the Flex-Side Bands: Place one included elastic Flex-Side band into each set of grooves on the drawers.
2. Test the Fit: Set the unit inside your cabinet and open/close the drawers to ensure they clear any cabinet door hinges or frames cleanly.
